name: spec-kit
description: 💫 Toolkit to help you get started with Spec-Driven Development
one_liner: A toolkit from GitHub that helps you write a clear spec for what you want to build before you let an AI coding assistant start coding it.
buyer: This is a free developer-productivity toolkit backed by GitHub itself — there's no realistic independent business to build directly on top of it, since GitHub already owns the distribution and roadmap.
business_use_cases: An engineering consultancy adopts it as their standard process for AI-assisted client projects, using 'spec-driven development' as a selling point.
A dev-tools trainer builds paid workshops teaching teams how to write specs that produce reliable AI-generated code.
A software agency uses it internally to reduce rework from AI-generated code that misunderstood requirements.

money_ideas.idea: Sell training/consulting services teaching teams to adopt spec-driven AI development using this toolkit.

steal_this: Not a product to build on — it's GitHub's own free methodology tool. The realistic move is offering a paid workshop teaching teams to adopt it well.
